baseline: original P01 full grid and P03 matched subset, original frozen checkpoints
occlusion: intact true-class raw logit minus logit after one atom feature vector is zeroed; topology unchanged; signed scores ranked directly
saliency: sum over input features of absolute gradient of intact true-class raw logit
occlusion_batch: all single-atom variants of one source molecule, matching original implementation
pilot: first 24 hash-ordered eligible dev molecules for B and benzene, both backbones, seed 42
bootstrap: 2000 paired resamples of 11 observed task clusters, seed 20260912; descriptive only
stop: source/checkpoint mismatch, mapping failure, nonfinite scores, failed selector or pilot parity, or projection above 30 days
claim_boundary: retrospective extension with reused predictors and previously inspected task distributions; finite-test pass counts are descriptive, not per-cell conformal guarantees; zero-feature occlusion is not chemical deletion
